subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

His __eloquent __speech moved the audience to tears.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Expressive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"eloquent"** refers to the ability to express yourself clearly, vividly, and persuasively, especially in speech or writing. (प्रभावशाली और स्पष्ट बोलने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The politician delivered an eloquent speech that inspired the crowd to take action.
 
 
 
• The word **"Expressive"** means effectively conveying thoughts or feelings through words, actions, or gestures. (भावपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** Her expressive eyes revealed her true feelings even though she said nothing.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"eloquent"** is **"expressive."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Expressive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vernacular** (स्थानीय भाषा): The language or dialect spoken by ordinary people in a particular region.
 
 
• **Example:** He wrote the poem in the vernacular of his hometown.
 
 
 
• **Inarticulate** (अस्पष्ट): Unable to express oneself clearly or effectively.
 
 
• **Example:** His inarticulate response made it difficult to understand his point.
 
 
 
• **Angry** (क्रोधित): Feeling or showing strong annoyance or displeasure.
 
 
• **Example:** She became angry when she realized she had been deceived.
